actions.label: Upload / Import
actions.purpose: Import an allowlisted local artifact through preview, provenance capture and runtime draft persistence.
side_effects: local file read through browser upload; optional runtime import draft write

actions.label: External editor
actions.purpose: Edit with an external local editor, then return to DevPilot for reconciliation, validation and governed review.
side_effects: external editor may change managed project source outside DevPilot; reconciliation is mandatory before trust

policy.server_authority: human-external-mode; DevPilot grants no external capability

actions.label: Validate current step
actions.purpose: Build a deterministic validation plan for the active workspace without executing arbitrary shell.
side_effects: plan only; source read-only

actions.label: Execute governed quality job
actions.purpose: Execute a registered quality/test/release job through the governed job runner when role and runtime prerequisites allow it.
side_effects: governed runtime outputs/evidence only; no arbitrary shell
